    sens_manager.scene.AddPointLight(ch.ChVector3f(16, 2.5, 100), ch.ChColor(intensity, intensity, intensity), 500.0)
    sens_manager.scene.AddPointLight(ch.ChVector3f(23, 2.5, 100), ch.ChColor(intensity, intensity, intensity), 500.0)

    # Create and configure a camera sensor.
    offset_pose = ch.ChFramed(ch.ChVector3d(-8, 0, 2), ch.QuatFromAngleAxis(.2, ch.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0)))
    cam = sens.ChCameraSensor(ground_body, 30, offset_pose, 1280, 720, 1.408)
    cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(1280, 720))  # Visualize the camera output.
    cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterRGBA8Access())  # Access raw RGBA8 data.
    cam.SetName("camera")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(cam)

    mag_handler = chros.ChROSMagnetometerHandler(mag, "~/output/magnetometer/data")

    cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterRGBA8Access())
    cam.SetName("camera")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(cam)

    lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(

    gps_ref = ch.ChVector3d(-89.4, 433.07, 260.0)

    gps = sens.ChGPSSensor(ground_body, 10, offset_pose, gps_ref, noise_none)
    gps.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterGPSAccess())
    gps.SetName("gps")

    acc = sens.ChAccelerometerSensor(ground_body, 100, offset_pose, noise_none)

    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(
        chros.ChROSCameraHandler(cam.GetUpdateRate() / 4, cam, "~/output/camera/data/image")

    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(
        chros.ChROSLidarHandler(lidar, "~/output/lidar/data/pointcloud")

    gyro_h = chros.ChROSGyroscopeHandler(gyro, "~/output/gyroscope/data")

    # 13) simulation loop

    time_end = 100.0
    while sys.GetChTime() < time_end:

        # publish to ROS, break out on failure
        if not ros_manager.Update():
            print("ROS manager update failed — exiting loop")
            break
        # advance physics
        sys.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

Below is a self‐contained Python script that uses PyChrono, its Sensor module and the ROS bridge to set up a moving ground body with a mesh, attaches a camera, lidar, GPS, accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer to it, and publishes all sensor outputs on ROS topics.  Make sure you have PyChrono built with the Sensor and ROS modules enabled, plus a valid “ground.obj” in your working directory (or change the path below).

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# simulation.py

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.sensor as sens
import pychrono.sensor.ros as sens_ros

def main():

    # 1) CHRONO SYSTEM SETUP
    # ----------------------
    # Create the physical system
    system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
    system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

    # 2) CREATE A MOVING GROUND BODY
    # --------------------------------
    ground = chrono.ChBody()
    ground.SetBodyFixed(False)
    ground.SetMass(10.0)
    # give it a little inertia so the motor can move it
    ground.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
    ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
    system.AddBody(ground)

    # Load a mesh from OBJ for visualization
    mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
    mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh("ground.obj", False, False)
    mesh_shape = chrono.ChTriangleMeshShape()
    mesh_shape.SetMesh(mesh)
    mesh_shape.SetName("GroundMesh")
    mesh_shape.SetStatic(True)
    ground.AddAsset(mesh_shape)

    # Attach a linear motor so that the ground moves in +X direction with constant velocity
    motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorLinearPosition()
    motor.Initialize(ground,             # my moving body
                     None,               # to the abs. frame
                     chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
    # ramp: pos(t)=t*vel → velocity = 0.2 m/s
    motor.SetMotionFunction(chrono.ChFunction_Ramp(0,  0.2))
    system.AddLink(motor)

    # 3) SENSOR MANAGER + ROS MANAGER
    # ---------------------------------
    sensor_manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)
    # enable filtering of all sensors through the ROS bridge
    ros_manager = sens_ros.ChROSManager(system,
                                       node_name="chrono_sensor_node",
                                       frame="world",
                                       freq=50)  # ROS publish freq

    # 4) CREATE AND REGISTER SENSORS
    # -------------------------------
    # Common pose for all sensors (relative to ground)
    # adjust each sensor’s offsetPose as desired:
    base_pose = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.0),
                               chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0, chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,1)))

    # 4.1 Camera
    cam = sens.ChCameraSensor(parent=ground,
                              update_rate=30,
                              offsetPose=base_pose * chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0),
                                                                     chrono.Q_from_AngY(-0.3)))
    cam.SetFOV(1.0)         # ~60°
    cam.SetResolution(640,480)
    cam.SetLag(0.0)
    # ROS filter to publish ROS Image (sensor_msgs/Image)
    cam.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/camera/image_raw", frame_id="camera_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(cam)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(cam)

    # 4.2 Lidar
    lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(parent=ground,
                               update_rate=10,
                               offsetPose=base_pose * chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0.1),
                                                                      chrono.QUNIT))
    lidar.SetHorizontalFOV(chrono.CH_C_PI)  # 180°
    lidar.SetVerticalFOV(chrono.CH_C_PI/6)  # 30°
    lidar.SetSamples(200, 16)
    lidar.SetMaxRange(20)
    lidar.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/lidar/points", frame_id="lidar_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(lidar)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(lidar)

    # 4.3 GPS
    gps = sens.ChGpsSensor(parent=ground,
                           update_rate=5,
                           offsetPose=base_pose)
    gps.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/gps/fix", frame_id="gps_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(gps)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(gps)

    # 4.4 Accelerometer
    accel = sens.ChAccelerometerSensor(parent=ground,
                                       update_rate=200,
                                       offsetPose=base_pose)
    accel.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/imu/accel", frame_id="imu_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(accel)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(accel)

    # 4.5 Gyroscope
    gyro = sens.ChGyroscopeSensor(parent=ground,
                                  update_rate=200,
                                  offsetPose=base_pose)
    gyro.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/imu/gyro", frame_id="imu_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(gyro)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(gyro)

    # 4.6 Magnetometer
    mag = sens.ChMagnetometerSensor(parent=ground,
                                    update_rate=50,
                                    offsetPose=base_pose)
    mag.PushFilter(sens_ros.ChFilterROSbridge(topic="/imu/mag", frame_id="imu_link"))
    sensor_manager.AddSensor(mag)
    ros_manager.RegisterSensor(mag)

    # 5) REAL‐TIME TIMER
    # -------------------
    realtime = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()

    # 6) MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
    # ------------------------
    timestep = 1.0/100.0
    while True:
        # Update all sensors (collect new data, run filters...)
        sensor_manager.Update()
        # Publish via ROS
        ros_manager.Run()

        # Advance the physical simulation
        system.DoStepDynamics(timestep)

        # Sleep to enforce real time
        realtime.Synchronize(system.GetChTime())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

import pychrono as ch
import pychrono.sensor as sens
import pychrono.ros as chros

def main():
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Create the Chrono simulation system
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    sys = ch.ChSystemNSC()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2) Add a mesh object to the simulation for visual interest.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    mmesh = ch.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
    mmesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(
        ch.GetChronoDataFile("vehicle/hmmwv/hmmwv_chassis.obj"),
        False, True
    )
    mmesh.Transform(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), ch.ChMatrix33d(1))

    trimesh_shape = ch.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
    trimesh_shape.SetMesh(mmesh)
    trimesh_shape.SetName("HMMWV Chassis Mesh")
    trimesh_shape.SetMutable(False)

    mesh_body = ch.ChBody()
    mesh_body.SetPos(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
    mesh_body.AddVisualShape(trimesh_shape)
    mesh_body.SetFixed(False)
    mesh_body.SetMass(0)       # mass=0 → static
    sys.Add(mesh_body)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3) Create a ground body (static) to which we'll mount all sensors
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ground_body = ch.ChBodyEasyBox(1, 1, 1, 1000, False, False)
    ground_body.SetPos(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
    ground_body.SetFixed(False)
    ground_body.SetMass(0)
    sys.Add(ground_body)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4) Create the sensor manager and set up scene lights
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    sens_manager = sens.ChSensorManager(sys)

    intensity = 1.0
    for x in (2, 9, 16, 23):
        sens_manager.scene.AddPointLight(
            ch.ChVector3f(x, 2.5, 100),
            ch.ChColor(intensity, intensity, intensity),
            500.0
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5) Create a camera sensor on the ground body
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    offset_pose = ch.ChFrameD(
        ch.ChVector3d(-8, 0, 2),
        ch.Q_from_AngAxis(0.2, ch.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))
    )
    cam = sens.ChCameraSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=30.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        width=1280,
        height=720,
        fov=1.408
    )
    cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(1280, 720))
    cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterRGBA8Access())
    cam.SetName("camera")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(cam)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6) Create a 3D LiDAR sensor, name all its filters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=5.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        num_rays=90,
        num_lines=300,
        horizontal_fov=2 * ch.CH_PI,
        vertical_fov_up=ch.CH_PI / 12,
        vertical_fov_down=-ch.CH_PI / 6,
        max_dist=100.0,
        min_dist=0.0
    )
    # raw depth image
    f_di = sens.ChFilterDIAccess()
    f_di.SetName("lidar_depth_access")
    lidar.PushFilter(f_di)
    # conversion to point-cloud
    f_pc = sens.ChFilterPCfromDepth()
    f_pc.SetName("lidar_pc_from_depth")
    lidar.PushFilter(f_pc)
    # XYZ+Intensity
    f_xyz = sens.ChFilterXYZIAccess()
    f_xyz.SetName("lidar_xyz_i_access")
    lidar.PushFilter(f_xyz)
    # visualize the point-cloud
    f_viz = sens.ChFilterVisualizePointCloud(1280, 720, 1)
    f_viz.SetName("lidar_viz")
    lidar.PushFilter(f_viz)

    lidar.SetName("lidar3d")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(lidar)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7) Create a “2D” LiDAR by constraining to 1 scan line
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    lidar2d = sens.ChLidarSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=10.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        num_rays=360,

        horizontal_fov=2 * ch.CH_PI,
        vertical_fov_up=0.0,
        vertical_fov_down=0.0,
        max_dist=50.0,
        min_dist=0.1
    )
    # raw depth image
    f2d_di = sens.ChFilterDIAccess()
    f2d_di.SetName("lidar2d_depth_access")
    lidar2d.PushFilter(f2d_di)
    # convert depth→laser scan
    f2d_scan = sens.ChFilterLidarScan()
    f2d_scan.SetName("lidar2d_scan_filter")
    lidar2d.PushFilter(f2d_scan)
    lidar2d.SetName("lidar2d")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(lidar2d)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 8) GPS, accelerometer, gyro, magnetometer (unchanged)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    noise_model_none = sens.ChNoiseNone()
    gps_ref = ch.ChVector3d(-89.4, 433.07, 260.0)
    gps = sens.ChGPSSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=10.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        reference= gps_ref,
        noise_model=noise_model_none
    )
    gps.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterGPSAccess())
    gps.SetName("gps")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(gps)

    acc = sens.ChAccelerometerSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=100.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        noise_model=noise_model_none
    )
    acc.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterAccelAccess())
    acc.SetName("accelerometer")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(acc)

    gyro = sens.ChGyroscopeSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=100.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        noise_model=noise_model_none
    )
    gyro.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterGyroAccess())
    gyro.SetName("gyroscope")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(gyro)

    mag = sens.ChMagnetometerSensor(
        parent=ground_body,
        update_rate=100.0,
        offset_pose=offset_pose,
        noise_model=noise_model_none,
        reference=gps_ref
    )
    mag.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterMagnetAccess())
    mag.SetName("magnetometer")
    sens_manager.AddSensor(mag)

    # initialize all sensors
    sens_manager.Update()

    # 9) Set up the ROS managers and handlers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    ros_manager = chros.ChROSPythonManager()
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSClockHandler())

    # camera
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(
        chros.ChROSCameraHandler(
            cam.GetUpdateRate() / 4.0,
            cam,
            "~/output/camera/data/image"
        )
    )
    # 3D LiDAR
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(
        chros.ChROSLidarHandler(
            lidar,
            "~/output/lidar/data/pointcloud"
        )
    )
    # 2D LiDAR → publish as LaserScan on a new topic
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(
        chros.ChROSLaserScanHandler(
            lidar2d,
            "~/output/lidar2d/data/scan"
        )
    )
    # GPS
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSGPSHandler(gps, "~/output/gps/data"))
    # IMU pieces
    acc_handler  = chros.ChROSAccelerometerHandler(acc, "~/output/accelerometer/data")
    gyro_handler = chros.ChROSGyroscopeHandler( gyro, "~/output/gyroscope/data")
    mag_handler  = chros.ChROSMagnetometerHandler(mag, "~/output/magnetometer/data")
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(acc_handler)
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(gyro_handler)
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(mag_handler)
    # Combined IMU
    imu_handler = chros.ChROSIMUHandler(100.0, "~/output/imu/data")
    imu_handler.SetAccelerometerHandler(acc_handler)
    imu_handler.SetGyroscopeHandler( gyro_handler)
    imu_handler.SetMagnetometerHandler(mag_handler)
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(imu_handler)

    ros_manager.Initialize()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 10) Run the simulation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    time_end  = 100.0
    time_step = 1e-3

    # spin the “ground” so that all sensors are in motion
    ground_body.SetAngVelParent(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.1))

    while sys.GetChTime() < time_end:
        sens_manager.Update()
        if not ros_manager.Update(sys.GetChTime(), time_step):
            break
        sys.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
